items.name: FindIter
items.summary: An iterator of non-overlapping matches in a particular haystack.

items.name: FindOverlappingIter
items.summary: An iterator of overlapping matches in a particular haystack.

items.name: OverlappingState
items.summary: Represents the current state of an overlapping search.

methods.name: get_match
methods.summary: Return the match result of the most recent search to execute with this state.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Create a new overlapping state that begins at the start state.

items.name: StreamFindIter
items.summary: An iterator that reports matches in a stream.

items.name: Automaton
items.summary: A trait that abstracts over Aho-Corasick automata.

methods.name: is_dead
methods.summary: Returns true if the given ID represents a dead state.

methods.name: is_match
methods.summary: Returns true if the given ID represents a match state.

methods.name: is_special
methods.summary: Returns true if the given ID represents a "special" state. A special state is a dead, match or start state.

methods.name: is_start
methods.summary: Returns true if the given ID represents a start state.

methods.name: match_kind
methods.summary: Returns the match semantics that this automaton was built with.

methods.name: match_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of matches for the given state ID.

methods.name: match_pattern
methods.signature: fn match_pattern(&self, sid: StateID, index: usize) -> PatternID
methods.summary: Returns the pattern ID for the match state given by `sid` at the `index` given.

methods.name: max_pattern_len
methods.summary: Returns the length, in bytes, of the longest pattern in this automaton.

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Returns the heap memory usage, in bytes, used by this automaton.

methods.name: min_pattern_len
methods.summary: Returns the length, in bytes, of the shortest pattern in this automaton.

methods.name: next_state
methods.signature: fn next_state(&self, anchored: Anchored, sid: StateID, byte: u8) -> StateID
methods.summary: Performs a state transition from `sid` for `byte` and returns the next state.

methods.name: pattern_len
methods.summary: Returns the length of the pattern for the given ID.

methods.name: patterns_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of patterns compiled into this automaton.

methods.name: prefilter
methods.summary: Returns a prefilter, if available, that can be used to accelerate searches for this automaton.

methods.name: start_state
methods.signature: fn start_state(&self, anchored: Anchored) -> Result<StateID, MatchError>
methods.summary: Returns the starting state for the given anchor mode.

methods.name: try_find
methods.summary: Executes a non-overlapping search with this automaton using the given configuration.

methods.name: try_find_iter
methods.signature: fn try_find_iter<'a, 'h>(&'a self, input: Input<'h>) -> Result<FindIter<'a, 'h, Self>, MatchError> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of non-overlapping matches with this automaton using the given configuration.

methods.name: try_find_overlapping
methods.signature: fn try_find_overlapping(&self, input: &Input<'_>, state: &mut OverlappingState) -> Result<(), MatchError>
methods.summary: Executes a overlapping search with this automaton using the given configuration.

methods.name: try_find_overlapping_iter
methods.signature: fn try_find_overlapping_iter<'a, 'h>(&'a self, input: Input<'h>) -> Result<FindOverlappingIter<'a, 'h, Self>, MatchError> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of overlapping matches with this automaton using the given configuration.

methods.name: try_replace_all
methods.signature: fn try_replace_all<B>(&self, haystack: &str, replace_with: &[B]) -> Result<String, MatchError> where Self: Sized, B: AsRef<str>
methods.summary: Replaces all non-overlapping matches in `haystack` with strings from `replace_with` depending on the pattern that matched. The `replace_with` slice must have length equal to `Automaton::patterns_len`.

methods.name: try_replace_all_bytes
methods.signature: fn try_replace_all_bytes<B>(&self, haystack: &[u8], replace_with: &[B]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, MatchError> where Self: Sized, B: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Replaces all non-overlapping matches in `haystack` with strings from `replace_with` depending on the pattern that matched. The `replace_with` slice must have length equal to `Automaton::patterns_len`.

methods.name: try_replace_all_with
methods.signature: fn try_replace_all_with<F>(&self, haystack: &str, dst: &mut String, replace_with: F) -> Result<(), MatchError> where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(&Match, &str, &mut String) -> bool
methods.summary: Replaces all non-overlapping matches in `haystack` by calling the `replace_with` closure given.

methods.name: try_replace_all_with_bytes
methods.signature: fn try_replace_all_with_bytes<F>(&self, haystack: &[u8], dst: &mut Vec<u8>, replace_with: F) -> Result<(), MatchError> where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(&Match, &[u8], &mut Vec<u8>) -> bool
methods.summary: Replaces all non-overlapping matches in `haystack` by calling the `replace_with` closure given.

methods.name: try_stream_find_iter
methods.signature: fn try_stream_find_iter<'a, R: std::io::Read>(&'a self, rdr: R) -> Result<StreamFindIter<'a, Self, R>, MatchError> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of non-overlapping matches with this automaton from the stream given.

methods.name: try_stream_replace_all
methods.signature: fn try_stream_replace_all<R, W, B>(&self, rdr: R, wtr: W, replace_with: &[B]) -> std::io::Result<()> where Self: Sized, R: std::io::Read, W: std::io::Write, B: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Replaces all non-overlapping matches in `rdr` with strings from `replace_with` depending on the pattern that matched, and writes the result to `wtr`. The `replace_with` slice must have length equal to `Automaton::patterns_len`.

methods.name: try_stream_replace_all_with
methods.signature: fn try_stream_replace_all_with<R, W, F>(&self, rdr: R, wtr: W, replace_with: F) -> std::io::Result<()> where Self: Sized, R: std::io::Read, W: std::io::Write, F: FnMut(&Match, &[u8], &mut W) -> std::io::Result<()>
methods.summary: Replaces all non-overlapping matches in `rdr` by calling the `replace_with` closure given and writing the result to `wtr`.
